summary: The Links class provides methods to ensure URLs have appropriate HTTP/HTTPS protocols and to generate HTML anchor tags for navigation.
purpose: To produce valid URL links by appending HTTP/HTTPS if absent and generating HTML <a> tags.

workflows.name: MakeLink
steps: Check if the URL has HTTP/HTTPS. If not, append 'http://'.

workflows.name: MakeLinkA
steps: Check if the URL has HTTP/HTTPS. If not, append 'http://'.
Create an HTML anchor tag with the URL and return.

business_rules: Ensure URLs start with HTTP/HTTPS before returning.
